text: Honestly, 30k can be enough if you’re careful. I don’t make a ton either, and I’ve had my dog for years. The monthly stuff — food, treats, basic vet — is totally doable on a budget. The real killer is emergencies. One surgery can be $3k-$5k easy. So the trick is: don’t try to save up $5k on your own. Get pet insurance. I pay like $35/month and it covers 80% after a $250 deductible. That’s the only reason I can sleep at night. If you can also put $50/month into a separate savings account just for the dog, even better. 1-2k leftover per year is tight but workable if you have insurance. Without it, you’re one bad day away from a really hard choice. Also, consider adopting an adult dog instead of a puppy. Less chaos, often already trained, and you’ll know more about their health upfront. You clearly care enough to ask this, which already puts you ahead of a lot of people. Go for it, just get the insurance first.
